title: Kusanagi Nene — Super Special Practice Session!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene! That was so so sooooo great!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was. You were concerned about the leadup and entry into the chorus, but the depth of your emotion really brought the scene to life before my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean that? I worked the hardest on that part, so I'm really glad to hear it.
Neneee! Miku! KAITOOO!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not even the time we agreed upon, and you're already here practicing on your own!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. That's why you're here too, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! Daily diligence is critical for a future star such as myself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. I came to practice my singing too♪ And we just ran into Rui and Robo-Nene over there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Though, I'm here to unveil Robo-Nene's newest function.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Miku
rows.Line:
A new function?
A new function?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? Rui, I let you take her because you told me she needed her regular maintenance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wish you wouldn't make that face. This function partially serves to protect Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Protect her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes! You see, Robo-Nene is equipped with both an anti-toppling mechanism and an impact-dampening mechanism that guards against damage in the event of a tumble...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And today, I've revamped the impact-dampening mechanism. Robo-Nene is finally equipped with her own airbags!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a test... Oh, Tsukasa. From where you're standing, would you mind charging straight into Robo-Nene at full force?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let me just...refuse, obviously! Robo-Nene may be fine because of her airbags, but what about me?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course... Hmm, I was hoping to get some practical data now that it's finished, but...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
There's a sound.
It's coming from above.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Above?
Whoooaaa! I'm faaalliiing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ahhh! Someone's falling towards us!!
Somebody green... Is it one of the plushies?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What was a plushie doing up in the sky?
Actually, that doesn't look like anyone I've seen around SE—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A chance to experiment!
Ah, rather... Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes! I'll act as a cushion with my airbag attachment!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Confirming velocity and point of impact... 3...2...1... Engage!
Bwuh?!
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! Nicely done, Robo-Nene! You made a fine cushion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, are you alright?
Ouchie... I-I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Nice to meetcha! I'm Kuchipatchi! Did you guys save me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our friend Robo-Nene there sent you all poof-boing with her airbags!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whoa! Thanks so much!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm glad you seem to be uninjured.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, why were you plummeting from the sky?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're not one of the plushies from this SEKAI, so I assume you wandered in from somewhere else...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Oh, right! I came here 'cause I heard some really pretty singing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, singing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm... I'll attempt to summarize what you've told us, Kuchipatchi...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Firstly, you've come here from a place called Tamagotchi Planet, which exists somewhere in our universe, or perhaps another one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I say you've “come here”, but it seems you're actually in a dream under the effects of the sleep-learning machine your tama friend Mametchi invented.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You were supposed to hear a sample performance of your choir piece when you used the machine, but for some reason, you heard Nene singing instead...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: It was so pretty, it took my breath away!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you... Still, what a rough day for you.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whaddaya mean?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? I mean, I know it's just a dream, but you're in a new place all on your own, right?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
But I'm happy I got to meet the girl who was singing!
Uhh... Can I call you Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. Let's keep it casual, Kuchipatchi.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!!!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Hehehe. Great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, this is hardly a good position for you to be in.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. If you at least knew a way to get home...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Kuchipatchi, did Mametchi tell you what to do in an emergency? Is there a way to cut the sleep-learning machine's power?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
Cut it? Uhh...
Oh, I know how to cut cake or bread!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's not going to help.
You don't want to be lost like this forever, do you?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! I'm lost!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You just realized that now?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Should I call you absent-minded, or laid-back...?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do?! If I don't go home, I can't eat any home cooking!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, is that all you're worried about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've pegged you as a glutton, Kuchipatchi...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you have that big choir recital, right? You and your friends were practicing for it together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can't we do something, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: About that. From what I've heard, it should simply be a matter of Kuchipatchi waking up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. You did say you're dreaming right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It then becomes a question of when you're going to wake...
Kuchipatchi, did you set an alarm for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Nope. But somebody at home should wake me up when it's morning!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, it sounds like we had nothing to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, hey, Kuchipatchi! Until morning comes, you should stay here and play with us!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Can I?! I was looking at the Ferris wheel!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Huh...? What's that big tent over there?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's where we put on shows.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Shows? The kind where you sing and dance?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right. Actually, the four of us also put on shows as a troupe called Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whoa...! Oh, so that's why you were singing, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: I know...! Nene, everybody! I wanna learn how to sing from you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For that recital with your group?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Yeah... See, I think it's my fault we didn't sound good together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: When we start singing, and in the middle too, I keep falling behind before I know it.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: That's why I wanted to get better at it with the machine Mametchi made for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Everybody's been practicing so hard. I'll be a real bother if I'm still bad tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Kuchipatchi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, say no more!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's all help Kuchipatchi get super great at singing♪

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
...!
Y-You'll really teach me?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I can definitely relate to wanting to do your best for your friends.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So let's do it together, Kuchipatchi!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys! I'm ready to learn!
